about: Undeclared-allergen recalls from openFDA's food enforcement reports (reported Oct 7 and Oct 14 2026), written Oct 25 to test allergy alerts: a red tag should say who must not eat the product (lib/agent/verdict.ts) and name the allergen read from the record (lib/notice-facts.ts allergenOnly). None of these recalls is in cases.json or cases-holdout.json. Ground truth is checked against openFDA by eval/verify-allergen.mjs without any Tagout code. Scored like the other sets (eval/score.mjs --cases cases-allergen.json --verified verified-allergen.json); `allergen` is the expected allergen chip.

expect.danger: Red: the unit's lot is printed in the recall, and the tag is an allergy alert for `allergen`.
expect.not-danger: Orange or green: a neighbouring lot the recall doesn't print.
